pairs.subject: sound-effect-generation
pairs.evidence: app/playground/triage/Judge.tsx:499 The Sound Lab triage module scores loop seams and sound quality but lacks continuous two-pass joint playback in the transport and provides no layer assembly mixer.

techniques.evidence: app/playground/triage/model.ts:377 Briefs effects envelope-first by formatting event, material, and space, supported by explicit duration and prompt influence controls.
app/playground/hunt/Audition.tsx:91 Hunt auditions and crowns single winner takes rather than providing tools to stack, align, and mix separate frequency/transient layers into a composite.
app/playground/triage/Judge.tsx:644 Triage scores loop_seam on loop takes but leaves loop unmeasured and halts playback on take end rather than playing across the seam twice through.
app/playground/triage/Batch.tsx:190 Precondition does not hold: the sound lab operates on standalone audio generation without video input, clip framing, or picture synchronization.
app/playground/triage/model.ts:344 Precondition does not hold: modules triage and hunt isolated effects rather than constructing an effects pass structured against picture cuts.

pairs.registryProposal: Consider defining explicit playback transport expectations for loop acceptance (e.g. requiring continuous two-pass joint audition in audio players) so interfaces can be mechanically verified against the seam listening standard.

declined.subject: sound-effect-generation
declined.reason: The score-spotting context is dedicated entirely to musical score placement against picture (pipeline step 4) rather than non-musical sound effect generation. The sound-effect-generation standard explicitly defines music as out of scope ('Where this subject ends: this subject produces non-musical sound to a brief. Music — sectioned, tempo'd, sung — is the neighbouring composition subject'). Per seat instructions prohibiting not-applicable pair verdicts, this pair is declined.
